comments.body: 2026-10-21: fixed on main in ae9e4da3. Cause, from tonight's run log: the watch judged each need correctly at 10 s, but its post to a maker that was mid-turn (approving these same dialogs) was deferred to the end of that turn, 1.5-2 min later, when the dialog had long been answered. A need that comes due while its maker is working, blocked or stuck (and not fetching mid-turn by hook) is now held and judged again once the maker is free: told if still true, dropped if not. A blocked notice says how long it has held; the advice names the callsign (pinned by a test).
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From tooling feedback, 2026-10-17, 0.16.1-dev on the Mac, four sightings in one parallel round: every plan-approval dialog in it produced one. The maker answered each Claude Code helper's plan dialog, and @muster's "<helper> is blocked at a dialog" notice arrived afterwards, about a minute after the answer in the one sighting timed to the second, with the helper already `working` and editing files. The maker read the pane each time to learn the notice was stale.

The maker watch (`crates/muster-daemon/src/messages/makers.rs`) tells a need once it has held for `SETTLE` (10 s). Some of these dialogs were answered within seconds of appearing, so either the pane read blocked after the dialog closed, or the notice was posted well after the watch judged it.

A worse variant, same evening: notices arrived for Codex helpers closed with `muster pane close` a minute or two earlier, naming the closed pane by a given name that a newer pane then held. Following the notice's own advice (`muster pane send --pane <name> --key ...`) would have pressed keys in the wrong agent's pane. 0.17.0 made given names repeatable (3f30373a); check which name the advice uses now (`panes.name_of` in `look`).

Fix candidates: before posting, check the pane is still open and still blocked, and drop the notice if not; say in the notice when the dialog appeared; name the pane in the advice by its callsign.
title: A helper's 'blocked at a dialog' notice arrives after the dialog was answered
